In Genie rounds 28 and 30 the freight notebook wrote ship costs above the sales price as '4.9K%' and '2.35K%' of sales, in 47 of its 2,939 rows in round 30.

A count's noun agrees with it: '1 prior order', '2 prior orders'. In Genie round 30, 4,172 of the uplift notebook's 12,494 rows and 9,302 of the lapse notebook's 27,261 read '1 prior catalog orders', and the network notebook's read '1 recipients'. A count and its noun are written by fmt_count(n, noun, plural=None), which gives the singular only for exactly 1, and a rank by fmt_rank(r), a whole number with thousands separators and its ordinal suffix, never through fmt_num; run_use_case() asserts the cases of both. In Genie round 31, 20,891 of the network notebook's 51,644 rows read '1 new recipients', 60 of the lapse notebook's 27,314 read '1 days', 38 of the Pareto notebook's 53,825 read '1 tickets', and the network notebook ranked senders as '1.01Kth of 51.6K'. A missing count gives 'unknown' and the plural, like fmt_num, never an error, and run_use_case() asserts that fmt_count gives 'unknown days' for (None, 'day'). A count is never negative, so fmt_count raises a ValueError on one, and a difference that can fall on either side of zero takes its words from its sign ('the window opened 13 days ago'): in Genie round 34, 1,418 of the lapse notebook's 27,298 rows read 'lapse window opens in -N days', such as 'opens in -13 days' for a customer 100 days after an order against a mean gap of 87 days. An amount that can fall on either side of its reference, such as a cost's excess over its peer median, takes its words from its sign the same way and writes its absolute value ('freight 216 below the lane peer median'): in Genie round 35, 1,427 of the freight notebook's 2,939 rows gave a reason such as 'excess freight of -766 over the lane peer median' for a line whose freight was below its peer median. A number of days, weeks or months is a count too: a reason the instruction words with a count before a plural noun, such as 'N days since the last order', is built as fmt_count(n, 'day') + ' since the last order'. In Genie round 37 the coupon-uplift instruction gave the reason 'N days since the last catalog order, against a typical M for its segment', and 51 of its 27,298 rows read '1 days since the last catalog order'.

Each top reason is one fact about the row with its number, never several facts joined in one, so the cap of 3 reasons holds for what the reader sees. In Genie round 30, 51,643 of a network notebook's 51,644 rows packed 5 facts into 2 reasons ('1 recipients, PageRank 0.00000646, component of 10 customers'), which passed a count of the array's elements. A fact may carry the reference it is compared with after ', against' ('134 days since the last catalog order, against a typical 162 for its group'), and a test's result is its own reason ('not significant (q-value 0.674)'), never joined to the value it tested; before the write the notebook checks that no top reason holds a second number after ', ' or '; ', apart from the reference after ', against' and a count with its minimum ('16 tickets, the test needs 17'), and stops on the first row that does; the check never reads the recommended action, whose next step names the record and its amount together. In Genie round 32 all 20,818 rows of the lapse notebook joined the typical reorder gap to the days since the last order with a bare comma, 1,255 of the Pareto notebook's 53,999 rows joined a share to its test result ('23.5% of its tickets above the class median other-line net paid, q 1; not significant'), and 55 of the network notebook's 51,644 rows wrote 'baseline 11.4%' after the rate it compares with. In Genie round 36 the freight notebook ran that check over its recommended action too, and its first run stopped on its own action 'Review before the next cycle: check the BOXBUNDLES charge on Order 159973 item 6792 via BOXBUNDLES NEXT DAY, lane TN-WV, excess freight of 7.35K'.

A score whose scale a reader cannot judge, such as a PageRank or an anomaly score, is given in the reasons as its rank by that score alone among every row that has the score, flagged rows among them ('12th of 4,000 senders by influence'), from rank(method='min') on the score with 1 for the strongest, never the row's own rank, which also sorts on the decision test, the flag and the expected impact, and never as the bare score. In Genie round 30 all 51,644 rows of a network notebook named the senders' influence only as a bare PageRank such as 0.00000646, which tells a marketing owner nothing about whom to target. In Genie round 32 the freight notebook wrote each row's own rank as its anomaly score's rank ('anomaly score ranks 1st of 2,789 scored lines'), which was wrong on 28 of its 2,789 rows, even taking a tied score as any rank its ties span: the line it ranked 1st holds the 21st highest score. A row without a score has no such rank: pandas' default na_option='keep' leaves it missing, so keep_reasons leaves the fact out, and the step asserts that no score rank exceeds the total its reason states. In Genie round 33 the freight notebook ranked with na_option='bottom', so all 138 of its unscored lines read '2,790th of 2,789 scored lines by anomaly score'.

A document label that carries a count never puts the number directly before a word whose form depends on it; it reads 'N in total' or 'N of M' instead, in English and in every fallback language whose nouns or adjectives change with the number, so a domain with one use case never reads '1 use cases' and a Russian deck of 22 cards never reads '22 сценариев'. Found in v1.3.0 by sweeping Inspire's own documents for the count-noun class of R187: 5 labels did it in 18 languages (85 label texts); Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Indonesian and Malay nouns do not change with the number, so their labels stay as written.

A Genie Code notebook's test runs never overlap: before a test run starts, every earlier unfinished test run of the notebook is cancelled, and each test run is submitted with retries off (the task's max_retries 0 and disable_auto_optimization true, since serverless otherwise retries a failed task on its own), because a retry that starts after a newer run replaces that run's rows for the same as_of_date. After the last run Genie Code checks that the output table's rows for its as_of_date carry the run_id its outcome returned. In Genie round 31 serverless retried a failed lapse test run after the final run, and the retry's 27,314 rows replaced the final run's.

Before the write, a Genie Code notebook checks that no top_reasons or recommended_action text holds the whole word 'unknown', 'inf', 'None', 'nan' or 'NaT' or the text '<NA>', and stops on the first row that does, so a fact whose number is missing never reaches the text. In Genie round 31, 6,496 of the lapse notebook's 27,314 rows, flagged 'no prior order history', still read 'unknown prior orders'. The check also covers entity_id, entity_label and segment_or_item, for the whole words 'None', 'nan' and 'NaT' and the text '<NA>' that a missing part leaves (never a value the data itself names, such as an 'Unknown' category) and for an empty part (two separators with nothing between them, or a separator at either end), and stops on a top_reasons or recommended_action text that holds a minus sign before a digit that follows no letter, digit or point; the output contract tells the instruction writer to leave a part that is missing on a row out of both columns. In Genie round 35 the freight instruction built entity_label from a carrier that a line without a ship mode lacks, and 9 of the notebook's 2,939 labels read 'Order 159907 line item 16609 (None)', while 11 of its segments kept empty parts such as ' |  | MN'; 173 of the Pareto notebook's 53,273 segments read like 'able / ' for an item without a class, from an instruction that wrote '' for the missing class and kept its separator.

When a weight such as profit has both signs and a share is computed on one side, the side is named in that share's own reason ('56.9% of its class's losses'), never as a separate fact joined to it. In Genie round 31 a Pareto notebook's reasons read '56.9% cumulative profit share in its class, head, ranked on losses'. A row of the other sign, which that share counts as zero, states its own amount against its group's total ('a profit of 1.2K, against its class's loss of 45.6K'), never a 0% share. In Genie round 32, 3,454 of the Pareto notebook's 53,999 rows read '0% of its class's losses', the zero its loss share gave every item of a loss-making class that did not lose money.

A date parameter such as as_of_date is a Python date, like the DATE values Spark returns, so it is converted with pd.Timestamp before it is compared with a datetime64 column. In Genie round 31 'Invalid comparison between dtype=datetime64[ns] and date' stopped a Pareto notebook's decide() on its first run.

A key, id, rank or count that can be missing, such as a count from a left join or from a NULL median, is held as pandas' nullable integer, pd.to_numeric(x, errors='coerce').astype('Int64'), never cast with astype(int), and int() or round() runs only in a function that returns first on a missing value, as fmt_count does, never behind np.where, which computes both of its branches on every row. In Genie round 31 the coupon-lift notebook's np.where(prior_orders.notna(), prior_orders.map(...round(x)...), '') still ran round() on a missing prior-order count and stopped with 'cannot convert float NaN to integer', and in round 32 the Pareto notebook's halo test cast its counts with astype(int), which raised IntCastingNaNError on the counts its NULL class medians left missing and cost a repair.

Every row's top_reasons is built by keep_reasons(facts), which takes (text, numbers) pairs in order and returns the texts whose numbers are all present (none of them missing by fmt_num's test, or inf), without a repeat and at most 3, and run_use_case() asserts its result on a fixed case, so no reason says 'unknown' in place of a number and the pre-write check never has to stop the run for one. In Genie round 29 a Pareto notebook's reasons read 'unknownx class ticket', in round 31, 6,496 of a lapse notebook's 27,314 rows gave a reason about a missing value, and in round 32 the pre-write check stopped a Pareto run on a zero-total group's share, which cost a repair. Each text is built before keep_reasons reads its numbers, so every function a fact's text calls returns a text for a missing number and never raises on one, and fmt_rank gives 'unknown' for None, NaN and pandas' NA, asserted: in Genie round 35 the freight notebook passed keep_reasons facts whose f-strings called fmt_rank, and its first run raised 'ValueError: cannot convert float NaN to integer' on a line without a rank.

The alert agreement in an anomaly use case's acceptance is the share of the first fit's top k alerts that are also among the second fit's top k, with k the smallest of max_alerts_per_run and the two fits' alert counts, so it lies between 0 and 1. Inspire's acceptance said only 'agreement on the top alerts between two fits', and in Genie round 33 the freight notebook's first stability check counted every alert the two fits shared over k, found an agreement above 1, and Genie Code repaired it.

Every column a Genie Code step adds is named after what it holds, never after a pandas or Spark DataFrame method or property such as tail, head, count, size, mean, sum, values or index, which an attribute read such as x_pdf.tail returns instead of the column; the business output columns keep their names. The rule reaches the instruction writer in the run pattern, so the instruction never names such a column, and the Platform Rules still read every pandas column as x_pdf['name']. In Genie round 35 the Pareto instruction defined 'tail = cum_profit_share > tail_cum_share', the notebook read out.tail, and its first run raised AttributeError: 'function' object has no attribute 'astype'.

A Genie Code notebook whose method builds a matrix with a row or column for each entity, item or decision variable (recommendation, network analysis and optimization) builds it as one scipy.sparse matrix from coordinate arrays and keeps it sparse: it scales rows or columns by a product with scipy.sparse.diags, such as the PageRank transition matrix diags(1 / out-degree) @ adjacency with 0 for a node without out-links, never by assigning to its rows, columns or elements, where a row assigned from a dense array stores each of its elements, zeros included, and it calls .toarray() only on a batch of rows; the network guidance runs PageRank on that sparse matrix with a dense rank vector. In Genie round 36 the gift-sender notebook was killed out of memory after reading its 72,759 edges, and Genie Code replaced the sparse row assignment of its PageRank transition matrix with a diagonal product.

Every row of a Genie Code business output is one entity at the grain of the use case's entity key column, or one entity with one of its items or periods when the method writes several for each entity, never a row of another grain: a segment's or group's finding goes to the summary step. Every entity of the population the decision acts on keeps its row, and one the method cannot score keeps it with its reason in data_quality_flag and the Monitor tier; the instruction never defines the population as the entities the method can score. In Genie round 36 the gift-sender target list put 3 segment rows at ranks 1, 2 and 4 among its 51,644 senders, and the lapse instruction defined its population as repeat buyers, so the 6,490 single-order customers that round 35 wrote as flagged rows had no row.

A Genie Code notebook drops the rows missing the time value or any column of the row key, the entity key and each column a row is scored per (such as the store of a store-item row), from the frame every later step uses: a row whose key misses a part names no entity and gets no row, so no key holds '<NA>', 'None' or 'nan'. The checks before the write and before the summary call look for every text Python and pandas write for a missing value, the whole words 'None', 'nan' and 'NaT' and the text '<NA>', listed once for all of them. In Genie round 36 the Pareto instruction said 'A row is one (`ss_store_sk`, `ss_item_sk`)' and 'Drop the rows without an entity key or time value'; its notebook dropped the lines without an item, kept those without a store, built entity_id with astype(str), and 6,898 of its 60,897 rows carried a key such as '<NA>-1'.

Each row of a Genie Code business output is told apart by entity_id with segment_or_item: when the method writes several rows for an entity, the item or period that tells them apart leads segment_or_item, such as the line item of an order line, before any group the row belongs to, and the rank breaks ties on that row key. Before the write the notebook checks that no two rows share both entity_id and segment_or_item and stops on the first pair that does. In Genie round 37 the freight-dispute instruction set entity_id to cs_order_number and segment_or_item to '<sm_carrier> | <lane> | <sm_type>', so its 2,939 order-line rows held 2,380 distinct pairs of entity_id and segment_or_item, the line item only in the label.

A Genie Code formatter treats every missing value as missing: fmt_num, fmt_count, fmt_rank and keep_reasons test a value with x is None or pd.isna(x), which finds None, NaN and pandas' NA and NaT, and run_use_case() asserts 'unknown' for pd.NA as well as for None and NaN, since a nullable column holds pandas' NA and float(x) raises a TypeError on it. In Genie round 37 the freight notebook's first run stopped in its formatter with the TypeError float() argument must be a string or a real number, not 'NAType', and fmt_num in each of the round's other 4 notebooks raised the same TypeError when called on pd.NA.

A Genie Code notebook fits, evaluates and scores every model on one list of feature column names, feature_cols, that holds no name twice, selecting x_pdf[feature_cols] each time, so every frame a model reads has the fit's columns in the fit's order, and scores another arm, such as the untreated arm of an uplift model, on a copy of the scoring frame with that arm's columns set before the selection. In Genie round 37 the coupon-uplift notebook's evaluation stopped twice on 'Feature names must be in the same order as they were in fit', the second time from a current and a prior copy of each demographic column under one name, and its scoring stopped on a counterfactual frame that selected treatment before adding it: 3 of its 4 repairs.

The Platform Rules carry every business output column with its type and meaning, and the action text of each priority tier, in the words the instruction writer reads, built by one function for both, and state that section 7 says how the use case fills each column and that these meanings win where it says otherwise, as the run_id meaning already was. In Genie round 38 the meanings reached Genie Code only through the writer's paraphrase: the delisting instruction gave value as 'effect size of the item's group concentration change', and the notebook wrote 898 distinct values on its 107,681 item rows; the freight audit instruction gave the anomaly score in top_reasons as 'its rank among scored rows', and 354 of the 357 score ranks its notebook wrote disagreed with the row's rank by that score.

A repeat the row-key check finds is resolved by putting the item or period that tells the rows apart first in segment_or_item, never by aggregating the rows to the entity key or leaving rows of the population out. In Genie round 38, with the check and no rule for resolving a repeat, the freight notebook wrote one row for each of 374 orders where round 37 wrote 2,939 order lines.

When the baseline itself misses the acceptance thresholds, every row is Monitor whatever its decision test gives, and the summary says so. The sentence is part of GENIE_BASELINE_VALUE_RULE, which the stop rule and a model notebook's Platform Rules both carry verbatim, so the writer cannot drop it. In Genie round 38 the coupon-uplift baseline missed min_auc 0.6 with an AUC of 0.487, the writer left the Monitor clause out of the stop rule it wrote, and the rows, whose uplift agreed to 5 decimals, went 495 to Act now and 1,979 to Review.

A data_quality_flag never names a property every row of the population has by its definition, such as the outcome window still open on every row a model scores; the summary states it once. In Genie round 38 the lapse notebook flagged 20,090 of its 27,298 rows 'censored, open window', the condition that puts a customer in its scoring population, so no row was 'ok' and every row was Monitor.

A score rank in the reasons is among every row that has the score, flagged rows among them, and the total it states is that count; the step asserts that no score rank exceeds the total its reason states, and no reason restates a count another reason of the row gives. In Genie round 38, 17 of the freight notebook's 374 rows read like 'anomaly score ranks 374th among 357 scored rows', and 51,643 of the gift-sender notebook's 51,644 rows restated their recipient count, such as '1 recipient, the test needs 5' and then '1 recipient'.

A Pareto analysis tests each contributor's own finding, such as its change in share against the prior period, with an effect size and a Benjamini-Hochberg corrected significance, and that finding is the contributor's value and decision test; a group's concentration, its Gini or its change goes to the summary, never to the value or the test of its contributors' rows. In Genie round 38 the delisting notebook tested each store and class group's concentration change, the test flagged every group, and all 107,681 item rows were Monitor.

A built notebook installs nothing: no pip line, no library install and no download, because Inspire runs in workspaces with no internet; it uses the libraries serverless environment 4 ships, the writer's environment line says so, and a cell that installs a package is refused. In Genie round 38 the writer turned 'the first cell you add' into 'the very first cell', and Genie Code put the lapse notebook's pip cell above Inspire's card.

A check for a text Python or pandas writes for a missing value, the whole word 'None', 'nan' or 'NaT' or the text '<NA>', matches each word of the check case-sensitively, 'unknown' and 'inf' among them, never with re.IGNORECASE, (?i), case=False or a lowered text, so neither a name such as 'Nan' or 'Nat' nor a category such as 'Unknown' matches; the entity, reason and summary checks share one wording. In Genie round 39 the gift-sender notebook checked entity_label with case=False and stopped on 'invalid text in entity_label'; 3 of its 51,644 senders, such as 'Nan Gil', have the first name Nan. The coupon-uplift and delisting notebooks checked 'unknown' in one case-insensitive pattern with 'nan', and TPC-DS gives 480,200 demographic rows the credit rating 'Unknown'.

A row the method computes no result for, such as an entity with no unit left to test, whose shrunken estimate is only its baseline, or one whose outcome window is still open, has a NULL value, never 0 or the baseline in its place. In Genie round 39 the gift-sender notebook wrote a value of 0.0, the shrunken rate of a sender with no recipient left to test less the baseline, for 27,108 of its 51,644 senders: 21,817 whose recipients were all already buyers and 5,291 with every recipient's conversion window still open.

A column cast to pandas' category dtype, as categorical_features='from_dtype' needs, is cast only in the frame a model reads, frame[feature_cols].astype(...), never in the frame later steps fill, label or write, where a new text raises 'Cannot setitem on a Categorical with a new category'. In Genie round 39 the lapse notebook cast its buy-potential column in place, and two runs stopped on that error, for 'no buy potential' and then for an empty text.

Another arm, such as the untreated arm of an uplift model or of its baseline, is scored on a copy of the scoring frame with that arm's columns set before the selection, scoring_pdf.assign(**{treatment_col: 0})[feature_cols], since the scoring frame has no treatment column of its own. In Genie round 39 the coupon-uplift notebook's baseline scoring stopped on KeyError "['treatment'] not in index", the class of round 37 in the baseline's arms.

Frames are stacked with unionByName over one column list selected from each, a_sdf.select(cols).unionByName(b_sdf.select(cols)), since unionByName stops on frames whose columns differ, such as fit rows and scoring rows without an outcome, and union pairs columns by position. In Genie round 39 the lapse notebook's leakage guard ran train_sdf.unionByName(holdout_sdf).unionByName(score_sdf) and stopped on NUM_COLUMNS_MISMATCH, 32 columns against 33.

The rank compares impact at 6 significant figures, so a difference of float rounding never orders rows, and the rule states a near-tie case the notebook's own rank function must return. In Genie round 39 the coupon-uplift notebook's first rows agreed to 12 significant digits, 0.01046220327498365 against 0.010462203274964887, so float rounding chose which customer ranked 1st.

The step that writes the share reasons of a signed measure asserts that none of them is a 0% share, since a row of the other sign states its own amount against its group's total; the assertion stays in that step, so a rate such as '0% of 5 closed recipients bought on their own' never stops a run. In Genie round 39, 2 of the delisting notebook's 53,296 rows, such as store 10's fragrances item 15369, still read '0% of its class's losses', against 3,454 of 53,999 rows in round 32 before the rule.

A Genie Code notebook that keeps the rows whose group key is missing labels them in a new column, such as `segment_group` set to 'missing', and groups on that column, since on serverless environment 4, which runs pandas 2.2.3, `len()`, `list()`, `sorted()` or `.groups` of a groupby on one key with `dropna=False` raises 'Categorical categories cannot be null' when a key is missing, and `get_group` cannot select the missing group. In Genie round 40 the lapse notebook built its Kaplan-Meier strata from `list(x.groupby('buy_potential', dropna=False))` and 2 of its test runs stopped on that error, and the freight notebook's first run stopped on it from `fit.groupby('sm_type', dropna=False).groups`.

A fact about the whole run, such as a significance test flagging every tested series, is one bool that an `if` tests before rows are assigned, never the row key of `.loc` or part of a row mask joined with `and` or `or`: pandas raises KeyError 'cannot use a single bool to index into setitem' on a Python bool, and on a numpy bool writes row 0 or 1 and appends a row labeled False or True, which corrupts the output without an error. In Genie round 40 the gift-sender notebook wrote `f.loc[all_sig, 'data_quality_flag'] = 'test flags every series'` and its first test run stopped on that KeyError; the significance rule now names the fact as one an `if` tests.

A unit below the test's minimum states its count once, in the reason that gives the count and the minimum, so no other reason of its row, such as its rate, states that count again. In Genie round 40, 24,025 of the gift-sender notebook's 51,682 rows read like '3 closed recipients, the test needs 5' and then 'conversion rate 100% over 3 closed recipients, against a baseline of 35.1%', a form of the restated count R209 forbids.

Every json.dumps in a Genie Code notebook passes default=lambda v: v.tolist() if hasattr(v, 'tolist') else str(v), since a comparison of numpy numbers, such as an AUC against its threshold, and an `and` of such comparisons are numpy booleans, which json rejects. In Genie round 41 the coupon-uplift notebook set metrics['accepted'] to an `and` of its AUC and PR AUC checks, and its first test run stopped on 'Object of type bool is not JSON serializable'.

A quantile of a survival curve fit on censored times, such as a Kaplan-Meier median, that the curve never reaches within its follow-up is longer than the follow-up, never missing or NULL, whatever a build step says: a reason states it as more than the follow-up ('more than 365 days'), and a date built from it, such as the day a lapse window opens, uses the follow-up's end. One constant holds the sentence, and both the closed-window platform rule and, for the execution families whose outcome is observed over a window, the instruction writer's prompt read it, so the writer never specifies NULL and Genie Code follows the rule where an older instruction does. In Genie round 41 the lapse-timing notebook's instruction said km_open_days is 'NULL when never reached', and km_open_days and km_median_days were None in all 7 of its segments, so no customer got a lapse-window date from the curve.

The step that writes the share reasons of a signed measure asserts that none of them is a 0% share on each share's number before fmt_num formats it, never on the reason's text, where a test for '0%' also matches '10%' and '100%'. In Genie round 41 the delisting notebook asserted R218 with `"0% of its class" in reason`, and its first 2 test runs stopped on 'Zero share reason at rank 14', whose reason read 10%.

A test run that Genie Code submits as a job passes {"execution": "Here"}, the Execution widget's name, in its notebook task's base_parameters, never its label `Execution`, which the run ignores, so the run launches the tagged job instead of running the test. In Genie round 41 the delisting notebook's test run 123456789000004 passed {'Execution': 'Here'} and launched its tagged job as run 123456789000005; test runs of rounds 27, 31, 39 and 41 passed the label.

Genie Code submits each test run in one command that first lists the active runs with their tasks (databricks jobs list-runs --active-only --expand-tasks) and cancels every run whose task runs the notebook's path, with or without /Workspace before it, which covers earlier test runs and the notebook's tagged job, and it never submits from two commands at once. Without --expand-tasks a listed run carries no tasks, so a filter on the notebook path matches nothing and cancels nothing. In Genie round 41 the delisting notebook's cancel step listed the runs without --expand-tasks, and its test runs 123456789000006 and 123456789000007 started 3 seconds apart, the second failing on DELTA_CONCURRENT_APPEND, the overlap R191 forbids; rounds 9, 23, 30 and 31 also had overlapping test runs.

Each run replaces only the rows of its own as_of_date, so after the last run Genie Code deletes the rows of every earlier test run of the session by the run_ids their outcomes returned, never a row of the last run or of a run before the session, and reports each as_of_date later than the last run's that the table still holds, with its run_id and row count, because readers of the newest rows read those rows. In Genie round 41 the delisting notebook's third test run resolved as_of_date 2003-04-01 and wrote 53,989 rows, and its last run wrote 53,999 rows for 2003-01-01, so the table's newest rows were the test run's; the shipping-charge notebook's table still held 2,789 rows for 2003-01-09, a day after its last run's as_of_date.

The reason that gives a unit's count and the test's minimum is added only to the rows below the minimum, first among their facts, never listed for every row, since keep_reasons drops only a fact whose number is missing and so moves a fact listed for every row into the reasons of a row that lacks an earlier fact; the step asserts before the write that no row whose count reaches the minimum gives it. In Genie round 41, 25 of the shipping-charge notebook's 2,939 lines, 23 flagged 'sales price missing or zero' and 2 'quantity missing or zero', read like '1.13K peer lines, the median needs 5', which R185 forbids.

A row's own value is never a top reason by itself, since the value column holds it; a reason states it only with the reference it is compared against ('repeat rate 100%, against a baseline of 35%'). In Genie round 41 the lapse-timing notebook's rows gave their own lapse risk as a reason, such as 'lapse risk 50.3%', on all 27,314 rows of its final run.

A reference a reason compares with names the rows it covers: pandas merge matches a missing key to every other missing key, so a row whose group key is missing is compared with a group it belongs to, such as its carrier's median, or its reason names the missing-key group ('against a median of 15 for lines with no known lane'). In Genie round 41 the shipping-charge notebook's first run gave lines flagged 'lane unknown' reasons such as 'ship cost per unit 100, against a lane peer median of 15', the median of every line with no known lane.

Every model a Genie Code notebook fits, the baseline among them, reads at least one feature that every row it scores has, such as the days since the entity's last event, and gets one when a build step lists none: an imputer fills a missing feature with one value, so rows that lack every feature a model reads all get one score, which is no result of their own. In Genie round 42 the lapse notebook's baseline read only prior_order_count, avg_order_value and days_since_prev_order, which a customer with one order lacks, and its median imputer gave all 31,998 single-order customers of 79,850 the lapse risk 0.503.

A comparison of a nullable column, such as an Int64 count, is <NA> where a value is missing, which np.where, if and a .loc mask reject ('boolean value of NA is ambiguous'), so it is filled with the answer a missing value gets, (n < m).fillna(False), before it picks rows. In Genie round 42 the delisting notebook held its tested and minimum ticket counts as Int64, as R195 says, and its first test run stopped on np.where(out['n'] < out['m'], ...) with that error.

A missing-value test finds None, NaN, pandas' NA and NaT with x is None or pd.isna(x), and inf only on a number (isinstance(x, numbers.Real) and math.isinf(x)), so a text such as a carrier's name is never missing: it never calls float() on its input, which raises on every text. In Genie round 42 the shipping-charge notebook's helper returned missing when float() raised, so every lane and carrier name was missing, its first run's top rows lost their references, and Genie rebuilt and reran it.

A summary fact whose value is missing, such as a correlation over a column that does not vary, is left out of the ai_query prompt or names why it is missing ('no correlation, since every sender has one recipient'), never fmt_num's 'unknown', which the prompt check stops on. In Genie round 42 the gift-sender notebook formatted a missing correlation with fmt_num, the check stopped its first run, and Genie rebuilt the summary and reran it.

A reason that states a date built from a survival quantile the curve has not reached, or the days to or since that date, says it is the earliest ('the lapse window opens in 192 days at the earliest'), since the quantile is longer than the follow-up and the date is only its lower bound. In Genie round 42 every buy-potential group's curve stayed above one half to 365 days, and the lapse notebook's 79,850 rows gave the window as a fact, such as 'the lapse window opened 36 days ago' for a customer 401 days after the last order.

A Genie Code notebook writes every step its instruction lists in full before the first run, the business output write and the summary step among them, and never a stub, a step whose body only raises, passes or returns a placeholder; an edit that does not apply is applied again, as the same complete build, after the notebook is read again; and a failed run is fixed and run again until a run returns its outcome, never reported as the result. The sentence is written once and used in the Platform Rules and in AGENTS.md, since the instruction writer paraphrases R105: of the 10 instructions of rounds 42 and 43, 1 kept its sentence that a stop never removes or stubs a step and 2 had no word on stubs, the round 43 lapse instruction among them. In Genie round 43 the lapse notebook's first edit did not apply, Genie Code wrote 7 steps that raise 'requires continuation', and it reported the failed run after 4.5 minutes with no row written.

A ratio of two Python numbers, such as a share computed for one row from the values itertuples() or to_dict('records') yields, raises ZeroDivisionError on a zero denominator, where a pandas column gives NaN or inf, so it is computed only when the denominator is above 0 (a / b if b > 0 else None), and a reason that states it is left out of a row whose denominator is 0. In Genie round 43 the delisting notebook's first run stopped on 'float division by zero' at an item with no untied ticket, and Genie made its share texts safe and reran it.

A per-unit minimum sample is computed once, with one function, from the sample the test computes on, before readiness checks it, and that value is passed to readiness, the test, the shrinkage and each reason, so readiness never prints another minimum than the one the test uses. In Genie round 43 the gift-sender notebook's readiness computed the per-sender minimum before the outcomes and printed 7, its test used 6 from the closed recipient windows, and Genie rebuilt readiness and reran it.

Spark rejects a window function in a filter, a join condition or a HAVING clause (WINDOW_FUNCTION_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_CLAUSE) as it rejects one inside an aggregate, so the window is computed in its own step, as a column added with withColumn, and the filter reads that column. In Genie round 44 the coupon notebook filtered on a rank window inside its filter, and its first run stopped with 'It is not allowed to use window functions inside WHERE clause' until Genie computed the rank first.

A window labeled by its first day, such as a month from F.trunc(date, 'month'), ends the day before the next window starts, so its closed test and the training choice test that last day (F.last_day(date) for a month, pd.Timestamp(m) + pd.offsets.MonthEnd(0) in pandas), never the label, which counts the window closed up to a month too early and lets its outcomes read the holdout's days. In Genie round 44 the coupon notebook chose its training months by the month's first day plus the 90-day horizon, its leakage check stopped the run, and Genie found that training eligibility used month-start instead of month-end.

On serverless, Spark Connect analyzes a DataFrame only at its first action, so a column that does not resolve fails at a later count, collect or write, whose error names the line that wrote it after 'was called from', and a later drop() or withColumn of that column never removes the expression from the plan: the code a fix supersedes is deleted. The sentence lives in the Platform Rules, never in the serverless rule the instruction writer reads. In Genie round 44 the gift-sender notebook kept a first is_pre_holiday column that read holiday_date, a column its frame lacks, dropped it and built the flag again, and its first run stopped 4 lines later at a count.

A stub includes a branch of a step that prints its work as done in place of doing it, such as a registration step whose accepted branch prints a message and returns an empty version: every branch does the work the instruction gives it, and a step prints only what it did. The sentence is part of GENIE_COMPLETE_BUILD_RULE, which the Run controls rule and the Genie Code AGENTS file share. In Genie round 45 the freight notebook's register step printed 'Candidate accepted; model registration is tracked in MLflow and alias champion is reserved for the approved version.' in 0.0 seconds, registered nothing, and Genie Code ran the notebook a second time to register the model.

A model notebook writes the version its registration call returned as model_version on every row the accepted model scores, and asserts before the write that it is not empty, so a registration that never ran stops the test run; '' stays the value of rows no registered model scores, such as the baseline's. In Genie round 45 the freight notebook's first run wrote its accepted Isolation Forest's 2,939 rows with model_version '' and nothing registered.

The feature every row a model scores has also takes many values across the rows, such as a number of days or an amount, and Genie Code adds one when every feature a build step lists is a category or a small count: such a model gives each combination of their values one score, which hundreds of rows share with one tied rank. In Genie round 45 the lapse notebook's candidate failed acceptance and its baseline, a logistic regression on a log of prior_order_count and one-hot c_preferred_cust_flag and hd_buy_potential, gave 27,298 customers 123 distinct risk scores, 222 customers per score.

A pyfunc wrapper subclasses mlflow.pyfunc.PythonModel, with import mlflow among the notebook's imports, and defines predict(self, context, model_input), since MLflow 2 rejects an instance of a plain class with a predict method. In Genie round 46 the freight notebook imported mlflow only inside its register step, defined its wrapper as a plain class, and its third run stopped at log_model with '`python_model` must be a PythonModel instance'.

A model reads its many-valued feature, such as a number of days or an amount, as its number, scaled or logged, also when a build step bins it to name each row's driver, which its coefficient times the row's scaled value gives, since quantile bins are categories and a model that reads only bins, categories and small counts gives every row of one combination of bins one score; the instruction writer of a model use case reads the same sentence as Genie Code. In Genie round 47 the lapse notebook's instruction binned days_since_prior_order and prior_order_count into n_bins training quantiles, one-hot encoded, for the baseline and the candidate, and the model gave 27,298 customers 3 distinct scores.

A notebook calls each library as the version serverless environment 4 ships defines it, never with an argument, a function or a default that a later release added; the platform rule names the same pins as the Environment line and is left out when the execution pattern installs no package. In Genie round 47 the lapse notebook pinned scikit-learn==1.6.1, called KBinsDiscretizer with quantile_method, which scikit-learn added in 1.7, and its test run stopped with 'got an unexpected keyword argument quantile_method'.

Every field of a struct that goes into an array, a when or a union with another struct is named with alias, since Spark names an unnamed field after its expression and structs built from different expressions are different types. In Genie round 47 the freight notebook built an array of F.struct(F.lit(label), condition) values, and its test run stopped with DATATYPE_MISMATCH.DATA_DIFF_TYPES.

Every KPI query Inspire builds returns a number the notebook can format: a SUM, AVG, MIN or MAX, a ratio and a metric view measure are cast to DOUBLE, counts stay integers, and a SUM, AVG, MIN or MAX over a column whose type is not a number is not computable, for the KPI and for a ratio's denominator. A notebook rebuilds each stored KPI query from its spec. In Genie round 48 the freight notebook ran Inspire's KPI query, a SUM over a DECIMAL(7,2) column that Spark Connect returns as a Python Decimal, and its summary step stopped with a TypeError until Genie Code coerced the value.

A frame joined to itself or to a frame built from it, such as its aggregate or a cross join of its distinct keys, renames its key columns first, since Spark resolves both sides' references to one column and stops with AMBIGUOUS_COLUMN_REFERENCE. In Genie round 48 the lapse notebook joined a cross join of its distinct customers and snapshot dates back to the orders it was built from on anchors['customer_sk'] == orders['customer_sk'], and two test runs stopped with AMBIGUOUS_COLUMN_REFERENCE; a serverless probe reproduced it and ran once the key was renamed first or both sides were aliased.

A notebook replaces inf with NaN in its numeric columns after the last step that derives a feature, such as a ratio or a log, and before a fit, a score or the write, since a replace done when the rows load leaves the inf of a later division or of the log of 0. In Genie round 48 the freight notebook replaced inf when it loaded its rows, then took the log of a lane peer ratio, and its fit stopped with Input X contains infinity.

Both Discovery Types measure each use case's data minimum before it is kept, and a use case short of a hard minimum is dropped with its reason; a use case the user asked for, and the strongest use case of a domain the user named, are kept and carry the reason instead.

A build counts the data before Genie starts. When the data is short of the method's minimum, Genie gets the measured numbers and must pick a method valid at that size, never a minimum the data cannot meet, and the user is told what changed; a minimum the user set is never lowered.

A use case of a decision kind names a decision or action and a measurable outcome in its name, statement or business value, or it is dropped at Q5 with Q5_T4_NO_MEASURABLE_OUTCOME; an informational kind is exempt and is labelled Informational in the catalog and the App.
